laws.rule: Serranía de San Luis National Park: MADES lists camping as allowed but publishes no official public visiting hours. Arrange access with park administration rather than assuming an open gate. The ministry recommends a four-wheel-drive vehicle because the approach road is in poor condition.

sources.title: Serranía de San Luis National Park official visitor conditions and location
sources.supports: Read directly: named department, access conditions, visiting hours where published, and camping allowed or prohibited.

local-law.note: Named protected site only. National public-use rules apply from the country record. Other departmental and municipal levels not yet checked; no admission amount reproduced.
